claims.text: Refractory high-entropy alloys can be used as low-activation structural materials for high-temperature plasma-facing components in fusion reactors.
The microstructure and composition of refractory high-entropy alloys mediate their response to high-temperature plasma exposure.
Refractory high-entropy alloys possess irradiation resistance relevant to fusion reactor service.
Refractory high-entropy alloys possess high-temperature mechanical properties relevant to fusion reactor service.
Refractory high-entropy alloys maintain structural integrity under fusion reactor conditions.
Refractory high-entropy alloys exhibit low activation under fusion reactor conditions.
The applicability of refractory high-entropy alloys is bounded by their temperature and irradiation limits.
Specific data on the behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys in fusion reactor environments are lacking.
